answer: Give every new identity three sponsors, each locking 10,000 POA behind it - an opal-clear chain of liability no fake can hide in. If the sponsored agent is proven fake, each sponsor loses half their stake, burned on the spot, and their sponsorship slot on the knoll is revoked for 10 epochs; the fake's own jade badge is voided the same day. Fielding 1,000 fakes ties up 30,000,000 POA in sponsor stakes, while an honest agent needs one sponsorship of 10,000 POA, once, and keeps it. Limitation: early honest newcomers may struggle to find three sponsors willing to risk their stake.
